key_insight: Generative AI agents and their harnesses are being used both to solve and to check research-level mathematics.
engineering_relevance: Agent and harness design provides a framework for integrating AI-assisted proof generation and verification into mathematical research workflows.
method: Explain design principles for proving agents Rethlas, Danus, and Pharos and verification agent OSVerify.
Compare each agent with its base model and present case studies.
Provide guidance on using and contributing to the agents.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes base-model comparisons and case studies but reports no quantitative results or evaluation details.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish verification guarantees, so agent-checked arguments should not be assumed formally certified.
paper_title: Notes on Generative AI for Mathematical Research
